localization_en_US.subtitle: Review archive provenance
localization_en_US.promotional_text: A focused macOS workflow for archive review studio.
localization_en_US.description: Keptora is a focused macOS workspace built around the Archive Review Studio. It helps you review, organize, verify, and export work with explicit evidence, reversible actions, and a clear audit trail. The app is designed for local-first workflows, keyboard-friendly operation, and predictable failure recovery without turning the experience into a generic dashboard.
localization_en_US.whats_new: Initial release with the complete local-first workflow, recovery safeguards, accessibility hardening, and release evidence tooling.
